biome.frostfall_bastion.desc: A fortress in a blizzard. Frozen tiles add 25% defense but slow attacks; ice covers absorb enemy shots until they shatter. The diagonal gates open from wave 8. Frost Wraiths join the waves; Seraphyne guards wave 10.
biome.frostfall_bastion.name: Frostfall Bastion
biome.label: Battlefield
biome.molten_crater.desc: Two basalt bridges funnel the east and west lanes. Lava vents erupt (telegraphed) beside them and hurt everyone; heated bridge nodes grant +15% attack. Flame Devourers join the waves; Ignaroth or Gravemaw guards wave 10.
biome.molten_crater.name: Molten Crater
biome.shattered_aether.desc: Floating islands over the rift. Aether rifts tear open between the lanes (telegraphed), dragging enemies together and stinging heroes inside; aether nodes grant +40 Elemental Mastery. Chaos Elementals join; Aetherion or Nyxhollow waits at wave 20.
biome.shattered_aether.name: Shattered Aether
biome.stormspire_citadel.desc: A citadel on a storm peak. Lightning strikes the battlements (telegraphed); lightning-rod nodes make heroes attack 10% faster. Storm Wisps join; Ironclad Warlord and Vaelith rule here.
biome.stormspire_citadel.name: Stormspire Citadel
biome.sunken_archive.desc: A drowned library. Tidal surges (telegraphed) wash enemies back but batter heroes standing in the water; the north and south stairs stay flooded until wave 6. Tome nodes shorten cooldowns. Arcane Mimics join; Thornmother and Mirrath await.
biome.sunken_archive.name: Sunken Archive
biome.verdant_sanctuary.desc: The classic battlefield: six open lanes and no hazards.
biome.verdant_sanctuary.name: Verdant Sanctuary

codex.reaction_formula: Reaction power = base × wave level + Attack × scale, boosted by Elemental Mastery and reaction bonuses. Reactions ignore Defense but not resistance. Each pair has a short per-target cooldown and chains stop after 2 generations.

enemy.aetherion.desc: Bombards the Crystal, marks heroes and summons Chaos Elementals; at half HP it fractures and unleashes Riftlings. A volley is always followed by an exposed window.
enemy.aetherion.name: Aetherion, the Fallen Crystal
enemy.arcane_mimic.desc: Copies the magic of heroes casting nearby into a shield. Kill it before casting near it.
enemy.arcane_mimic.name: Arcane Mimic
enemy.ash_imp.desc: Ignaroth's spawn. Bursts into flame when it dies, scorching heroes beside it.
enemy.ash_imp.name: Ash Imp
enemy.ashen_matriarch.desc: Brood mother of Ash Imps; marks heroes with fire and, below 40%, unleashes Ember Hounds. Weak to Water.
enemy.ashen_matriarch.name: Ashen Matriarch
enemy.banner.desc: Nearby enemies gain +25% speed and +15 Defense. Kill it first.
enemy.banner.name: Banner Imp
enemy.blight_shambler.desc: Regenerates quickly unless it is Burning or Poisoned.
enemy.blight_shambler.name: Blight Shambler
enemy.chaos_elemental.desc: Every few seconds it shifts to resist one element by 60% and takes 15% more from all others. Mixed teams shine.
enemy.chaos_elemental.name: Chaos Elemental
enemy.crystal_parasite.desc: Darts past heroes and latches onto the Crystal. Latched parasites take 60% less damage unless a hero guards the core; Light or any cleanse rips them off.
enemy.crystal_parasite.name: Crystal Parasite
enemy.ember_hound.desc: A fast runner that resists Fire. Weak to Water.
enemy.ember_hound.name: Ember Hound
enemy.flame_devourer.desc: Shrugs off Fire, and every Fire hit stokes its speed. Weak to Water: swap damage sources or Vaporize it.
enemy.flame_devourer.name: Flame Devourer
enemy.frost_wraith.desc: Phases through attacks (35% less damage) unless Illuminated, glides over ground fields and shrugs off slows.
enemy.frost_wraith.name: Frost Wraith
enemy.glacier_golem.desc: A frontal ice shield blocks attacks from the front. Flank it or melt it with Fire.
enemy.glacier_golem.name: Glacier Golem
enemy.goblin_sprinter.desc: Fragile runner that bursts into a sprint every few seconds. Slows, roots and wide coverage on its lane stop it.
enemy.goblin_sprinter.name: Goblin Sprinter
enemy.gravemaw.desc: Very slow and heavily armoured. Shells the Crystal area, then vents its armour—strike while it is Exposed. At half HP it breaches forward along its lane.
enemy.gravemaw.name: Gravemaw, the Siege Titan
enemy.grunt.desc: Basic melee attacker. Fights heroes in its way.
enemy.grunt.name: Rift Grunt
enemy.hex_binder.desc: Ranged caster that periodically Silences the nearest hero, blocking skills. Steadfast heroes and cleanses counter it.
enemy.hex_binder.name: Hex Binder
enemy.hexcaster.desc: Ranged. Targets heroes from 3.6 m, then the Crystal.
enemy.hexcaster.name: Hexcaster
enemy.ice_statue.desc: Seraphyne's guardian. While any statue stands she takes 45% less damage. Statues are immobile and melt fast to Fire.
enemy.ice_statue.name: Ice Statue
enemy.ignaroth.desc: Erupts lava under heroes (watch the telegraphs) and summons Ash Imps. At half HP it Overheats: resists Fire, is weak to Water and Ice, scorches nearby heroes, and periodically vents—strike while it is Exposed.
enemy.ignaroth.name: Ignaroth, the Ember Tyrant
enemy.ironback_golem.desc: Heavy plates halve basic-attack damage until its armour is cracked or Corroded. Use skills, reactions, Earth or Poison.
enemy.ironback_golem.name: Ironback Golem
enemy.ironclad_warlord.desc: Heavily armoured; shells the Crystal and sends Goblin Sprinters. After each volley his guard drops.
enemy.ironclad_warlord.name: Ironclad Warlord
enemy.juggernaut.desc: Huge and crowd-control resistant (65% shorter stuns, slows and pushes).
enemy.juggernaut.name: Juggernaut
enemy.mana_leech.desc: Drains magic: heroes within 2.6 m recover skill cooldowns 35% slower. Kill it first, or bring Steadfast heroes and cleanses.
enemy.mana_leech.name: Mana Leech
enemy.mimic.desc: Adapts: every 3s it hardens against the element that hurt it most (partial resistance).
enemy.mimic.name: Prism Mimic
enemy.mirrath.desc: Reflects skill damage and summons Mirror Knights that shield her while they stand. Break the knights, then strike. Weak to Void.
enemy.mirrath.name: Mirrath, the Mirror Queen
enemy.mirror_knight.desc: Reflects 25% of hero skill damage back at the caster (never lethal). Basic attacks, damage over time and reactions are safe.
enemy.mirror_knight.name: Mirror Knight
enemy.nyxhollow.desc: Marks heroes with void, spills Riftlings and raises Rift Summoners that shield it. Weak to Light.
enemy.nyxhollow.name: Nyxhollow, the Hungering Void
enemy.ravager.desc: Elite. Telegraphs a charging slam at the most threatening hero.
enemy.ravager.name: Ravager
enemy.rift_summoner.desc: Opens small rifts that spill Riftlings. Focus it down or Seal it.
enemy.rift_summoner.name: Rift Summoner
enemy.rift_warden.desc: Final boss. Phase 1 summons; phase 2 marks a lane and assaults down it; phase 3 casts three slams then is Exposed (+50% damage taken).
enemy.rift_warden.name: The Rift Warden
enemy.riftling.name: Riftling
enemy.rootbound_treant.desc: Entangles the nearest hero, silencing skills. Steadfast and cleanses counter it; weak to Fire.
enemy.rootbound_treant.name: Rootbound Treant
enemy.runner.desc: Very fast. Ignores heroes unless body-blocked.
enemy.runner.name: Rift Hound
enemy.sapper.desc: Ignores heroes and taunts; detonates on the Crystal for heavy damage.
enemy.sapper.name: Bomb Sapper
enemy.seraphyne.desc: Marks the ground with frost that freezes heroes standing in it (watch the telegraphs). Raises Ice Statues that shield her, then unleashes a blizzard that slows nearby heroes' attacks. Weak to Fire.
enemy.seraphyne.name: Seraphyne, Queen of Winter
enemy.shieldbearer.desc: Armored; its tower shield blocks 60% of frontal hits. Strike from the side or crack its armor.
enemy.shieldbearer.name: Shieldbearer
enemy.siege_colossus.desc: Stops far from the core and shells the Crystal with telegraphed artillery. Flankers and long range reach it.
enemy.siege_colossus.name: Siege Colossus
enemy.siegebreaker_golem.desc: Mini-boss. Telegraphed charge slams; at 50% HP gains heavy armor for 7s. Armor Crack and Superconduct cut through it.
enemy.siegebreaker_golem.name: Siegebreaker Golem
enemy.soul_binder.desc: Links up to 3 nearby allies: they take 40% less damage and the binder absorbs that share. Kill the binder to break the links.
enemy.soul_binder.name: Soul Binder
enemy.spirit_splitter.desc: Splits into two Spirit Wisps when it dies. Area damage cleans up both halves.
enemy.spirit_splitter.name: Spirit Splitter
enemy.spirit_wisp.desc: A quick fragment of a Spirit Splitter. Wisps never split again.
enemy.spirit_wisp.name: Spirit Wisp
enemy.spore_carrier.desc: Releases a spore cloud on death that regenerates enemies inside. Kill it away from the pack; weak to Fire.
enemy.spore_carrier.name: Spore Carrier
enemy.stone_burrower.desc: Tunnels underground where it cannot be hit, then surfaces near the core after a short rumble. Keep defenders on the inner ring.
enemy.stone_burrower.name: Stone Burrower
enemy.storm_harpy.desc: Flies straight at the Crystal over walls and ground fields. Melee heroes hit it for half; ranged heroes are the answer.
enemy.storm_harpy.name: Storm Harpy
enemy.storm_wisp.desc: A small flyer that zips over walls and fields.
enemy.storm_wisp.name: Storm Wisp
enemy.summoner.desc: Opens portals that release Swarmlings every 6s.
enemy.summoner.name: Rift Summoner
enemy.swarmling.desc: Tiny and fragile, comes in crowds. AoE shines.
enemy.swarmling.name: Swarmling
enemy.thornmother.desc: Regenerates unless Burning or Poisoned, roots heroes with thorn marks and calls Blight Shamblers. Weak to Fire.
enemy.thornmother.name: Thornmother
enemy.thunder_drummer.desc: War drums hasten and armour nearby enemies. Silence the drums first.
enemy.thunder_drummer.name: Thunder Drummer
enemy.vaelith.desc: Calls lightning on heroes (telegraphed, brief stun) and storm wisps. At half HP she quickens—strike during her exposed windows. Weak to Earth.
enemy.vaelith.name: Vaelith, the Storm Tyrant
enemy.void_priest.desc: Channels a heal on nearby enemies. Any stun interrupts the channel; focus it down first.
enemy.void_priest.name: Void Priest
enemy.warded.desc: Resists all elements a little and one element heavily (shown by its ward).
enemy.warded.name: Warded Golem
event.challenge_altar.desc: Runes promise rewards for a harder next wave.
event.challenge_altar.name: Challenge Altar

event.challenge_altar.opt1: Accept the Haste trial: +8 Gold now.

event.rift_merchant.name: Rift Merchant

event.wandering_healer.name: Wandering Healer

settings.title: Settings
status.charged.desc: Carries Lightning; the next different element reacts.
status.chill.desc: Moves 15% slower; Fire melts it for big damage.
status.doom.desc: Stacks up to 5. Non-bosses at or below 4% HP per stack are executed (half on elites); bosses take +3% damage per stack.
status.illuminated.desc: Purified: loses 50% shield and support buffs when lit, deals 15% less damage for 4s.
status.poisoned.desc: Stacking damage over time (max 10). At 5+ stacks: Corroded (-30% Defense). On death half the stacks jump to a neighbour (max 2 hops).
status.resonant.desc: The next reaction on this enemy deals +30% damage, then the mark fades.
status.rooted.desc: Held in place for 0.8s but can still attack; 1.5s immunity afterwards. Bosses are slowed instead.
status.unstable.desc: At 3 stacks the enemy collapses: a short pull and Void damage around it (2s cooldown, bosses are not pulled).
status.wet.desc: Primed for Water reactions (Vaporize, Electrocharge, Freeze...).
status.windmark.desc: Takes +10% Wind damage; Wind spreads it.
team.ascension_desc.10: + Bosses enrage harder; enemies +10% HP. The true trial.
team.ascension_desc.3: + Crystal starts with 15% less max HP; one defense node is blocked each wave (shown in preparation).
team.ascension_desc.4: + Enemies deal 10% more damage; elites carry an affix.
team.ascension_desc.5: + Bosses enrage below 25% HP (+25% damage). Enemy HP scales 8% per level.
team.ascension_desc.7: + Every 8th regular enemy is an elite.
team.ascension_desc.8: + Epic/legendary offers 30% rarer; Crystal -10% max HP.
team.ascension_desc.9: + Enemies +10% damage; hazards fire 30% more often.
